issue: _project() replaces the project dir with the nearest git root (and a worktree with main root), so a projectPath below the repo root never applies; contradicts the CHANGELOG/docstring claim that the project is $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR Scenario: Repo /repo/.git, Claude project /repo/app recorded at rails-stack 1.63.0, another project on 1.69.0: CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=/repo/app resolves _project()=/repo, record skipped, glob returns 1.69.0 (reproduced) - the #1421 bug. Fix: return `here` when .git is a dir; for a worktree return main/here.relative_to(d); add a fixture.

A matching record whose installPath lacks skills/design-system returns [clone, mine] only; find() is None with no glob fallback, contradicting 'resolves no worse than it did' Scenario: Record points at a pruned 1.63.0 dir while 1.69.0 is cached: find() None (reproduced), every caller refuses. Fix: filter mine to records whose installPath/SKILL_REL is_dir, or reword the docstring to say refusal is intended.

Malformed record field types raise TypeError out of find(): non-str projectPath (line 84), mixed-type lastUpdated (116), non-str installPath (116) Scenario: projectPath:123 or installPath:[..] or lastUpdated 1 vs 'z' raises TypeError (reproduced); all six callers crash instead of taking the fallback. Fix: isinstance(str) filters, or catch TypeError.

The rule is said to be 'toolchain_version.applies_to's rule restated', but the samefile case-fold branch is not in applies_to (toolchain_version.py:118) Scenario: If a projectPath differs only in case, design-flow loads that project's version but /rails-flow:toolchain-check treats the record as not applying and reports a different one. Fix: port the branch to applies_to, or document the divergence.

The case-fold carve-out has no mutation, and its fixture is skipped on case-sensitive CI (selftest line 223): carve-out-without-negative-test Scenario: Deleting the samefile branch passes the Linux CI. Fix: a fixture that stubs os.path.samefile / Path.exists so the branch runs on any volume, then add the mutation.

No selftest fixtures for: a project below the git root, a record without installPath, a non-list records value, a relative gitdir (which works when probed) Scenario: B1 and S1 ship green because no fixture covers them.

A bare-repo worktree (gitdir /x/repo.git/worktrees/wt) maps to /x, the directory that holds repo.git, which is not a checkout Scenario: A worktree of a bare clone never matches its record and falls back to newest. Fix: when gitdir.parent.parent is not named .git, keep d.

The llm_tell_detector guard's staged baseline times out (>120s) at base AND head, so this is pre-existing and not from this PR: the staged selftest runs 0.74s in-tree but hangs from a /var/folders tempdir Scenario: The guard reports 'unmutated baseline timed out' locally at load 25+. Likely cause [Inferred]: in the staged layout, base resolves to /var/folders/<x>/<y> and the */*/skills/design-system glob walks every tempdir. Fix: bound the glob, or give the guard needs a fake marketplace root. Track it in an issue.
